name.description: The language's own name for itself.

status.description: source: the source locale. draft: being translated; not offered by any release. active: maintained and reviewed. Whether a release ships it is said by that release, not here.

fallback.description: The locale read when a message is missing, stale or not yet approved. Chosen explicitly — no subtag is stripped automatically. Required unless status is source. Chains end at the source locale and have no cycle (checked across files).
